claims.statement: The winged cat is a theme in artwork and legend dating back to prehistory, especially depictions of big cats with eagle wings in Eurasia and North Africa.
claims.statement_id: Kucing bersayap merupakan tema dalam karya seni dan legenda sejak masa prasejarah, terutama penggambaran kucing besar bersayap elang di Eurasia dan North Africa.
claims.quote: The winged cat – a feline with wings like a bird, bat or other flying creature – is a theme in artwork and legend going back to prehistory, especially mythological depictions of big cats with eagle wings in Eurasia and North Africa.

claims.statement: Belief in domestic cats with wings persists to the present day as an urban legend.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan tentang keberadaan kucing peliharaan bersayap tetap bertahan hingga zaman modern sebagai legenda urban.
claims.quote: Belief in domestic cats with wings persists to the present day as an urban legend.

claims.statement: Sightings of winged cats are explained by medical conditions such as matted fur or loose skin flapping like wings.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan kucing bersayap dapat dijelaskan oleh kondisi medis seperti bulu kusut atau kulit kendur yang tampak seperti sayap saat berlari.
claims.quote: Sightings of cats with supposed wings are easily explained by medical conditions that can result in matted hair, loose skin, or supernumerary limbs on or near the shoulders, that flap about in a wing-like manner as the cat runs.

claims.statement: Aq Bars is a legendary winged snow leopard stemming from ancient Turkic and Bulgar origins.
claims.statement_id: Aq Bars adalah macan tutul salju bersayap legendaris yang berasal dari bangsa Turkic dan Bulgar kuno.
claims.quote: Aq Bars is a legendary winged snow leopard, a symbol of ancient Turkic and Bulgar origin, and going back to an uncertain period in pre-literate history.

claims.statement: In the Book of Daniel, the first visionary beast resembled a winged lion.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Daniel, binatang pertama dalam penglihatan digambarkan menyerupai singa bersayap.
claims.quote: In the Book of Daniel of the Hebrew Bible and Christian Old Testament, the first beast in the vision of the beasts from the sea (chapter 7, dating to around the 2nd century BC) resembled a winged lion.

claims.statement: In medieval Christianity, demons were sometimes depicted as bat-winged cats associated with demonic symbolism.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi Kristen abad pertengahan, kucing dan kelelawar diasosiasikan dengan iblis, dan demon terkadang digambarkan sebagai kucing bersayap kelelawar.
claims.quote: In later, medieval Christianity, both cats (of the domestic sort) and bats were associated with the Devil, and demons were sometimes depicted as bat-winged cats.

claims.quote: Its arrival is viewed as a sign of good fortune and a supernatural source of hope.

claims.statement: In Oromo mythology of Ethiopia, Holawaka is a legendary bird sent by gods as a messenger to humanity.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi bangsa Oromo di Ethiopia, Holawaka adalah burung legendaris yang dikirim para dewa sebagai utusan kepada manusia.
claims.quote: In the mythology of the Oromo people of Ethiopia, Holawaka is a legendary bird sent by the gods as a messenger to humanity.

claims.statement: The gods instructed Holawaka to tell humans they would be immortal by stripping off their skins.

claims.statement: Lukwata is a legendary water-dwelling creature in Baganda folklore in Lake Victoria in Uganda.
claims.statement_id: Lukwata adalah makhluk air legendaris dalam cerita rakyat Baganda di Danau Victoria kawasan Uganda.
claims.quote: Lukwata (Luganda for 'sea serpent', the nominal form of kukwata, lit. 'to seize') is a legendary water-dwelling creature in Baganda folklore, said to be found in Lake Victoria or at least the Uganda portion of the lake.

claims.statement: It is described as 20–30 feet long with dark smooth skin and rounded head, attacking fishermen and boats.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini digambarkan memiliki panjang 20-30 kaki, berkulit gelap mulus, berkepala bundar, dan menyerang nelayan serta perahu.
claims.quote: It has been described as 20–30 feet long, with dark smooth skin and a rounded head, and known to attack fishermen and boats.

claims.statement: Pieces of Lukwata were thought to have magical properties and revered as relics.
claims.statement_id: Potongan dari Lukwata dipercaya memiliki khasiat magis dan dihormati sebagai relik.
claims.quote: Pieces of the Lukwata were thought to have magical properties and were revered as relics in eastern Africa.

claims.statement: Lukwata remains an important part of the cultural identity of the Baganda people in Uganda.
claims.statement_id: Lukwata tetap menjadi bagian penting dari warisan budaya Uganda dan identitas budaya suku Baganda.
claims.quote: Despite this, the Lukwata remains an important part of the cultural and historical fabric of Uganda and the cultural identity of the Baganda people.

claims.statement: Colonial administrator C. W. Hobley recorded in 1913 that people around Lake Victoria told stories of Lukwata.
claims.statement_id: Administrator kolonial C. W. Hobley mencatat pada tahun 1913 bahwa penduduk di sekitar Danau Victoria menceritakan kisah tentang Lukwata.
claims.quote: British colonial administrator C. W. Hobley wrote, in 1913, that people living on both (east and west) sides of Lake Victoria told stories of the Lukwata.

claims.statement: Its folklore may have been related to spirits and deities surrounding canoes and fishing.
claims.statement_id: Cerita rakyatnya mungkin berkaitan dengan pemujaan roh dan dewa pelindung perahu kano dan penangkapan ikan.
claims.quote: It's stories and folklore may have also been related in some way to stories of spirits and deities surrounding canoes and fishing.

claims.statement: Mbwiri is a Central African demon said to possess people.
claims.statement_id: Mbwiri adalah demon di kawasan Central African yang dikatakan merasuki orang.
claims.quote: Mbwiri is a Central African demon who is said to possess people.

claims.statement: Those he possesses would usually be diagnosed with epilepsy by a doctor.
claims.statement_id: Mereka yang dirasukinya biasanya didiagnosis menderita epilepsi oleh dokter.
claims.quote: Those he possesses would usually be diagnosed with epilepsy by a doctor.

claims.statement: When such a possession occurs, a shaman is summoned.
claims.statement_id: Ketika kerasukan semacam itu terjadi, dukun pengobat dipanggil.
claims.quote: When such a possession occurs, the shaman is called.

claims.statement: A hut is built where the afflicted resides with the shaman until cured.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah pondok dibangun tempat penderita tinggal bersama dukun hingga sembuh.
claims.quote: A hut is built in which the afflicted resides along with the shaman and his assistants until he is cured.

claims.statement: Mbwiri is said to abhor good living and merrymaking, making this the best way to drive him out.
claims.statement_id: Mbwiri dikatakan membenci kehidupan yang menyenangkan dan inilah cara terbaik untuk mengusirnya.
claims.quote: Mbwiri is said to abhor good living and this is the best way to drive him out.

claims.statement: When cured, he builds a little fetish house and avoids certain foods.
claims.statement_id: Setelah dinyatakan sembuh, ia mendirikan rumah sesembahan kecil dan menghindari makanan tertentu.
claims.quote: When he is pronounced cured, he builds a little fetish house and thenceforth avoids certain kinds of food and performs certain duties.

claims.statement: Aruan of Udo was a mythical prince in the ancient city of Benin born to Oba Ozolua in the 16th century.
claims.statement_id: Aruan of Udo adalah pangeran mitos di kota kuno Benin yang lahir dari Oba Ozolua dan Queen Ohonmi pada abad ke-16.
claims.quote: Aruan of Udo refers to a Benin mythical prince in the ancient city of Benin, born to Oba Ozolua by Queen Ohonmi in 16th Century.

claims.statement: According to Benin's oral history, Aruan was a giant who could sweep the city using palm trees.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sejarah lisan Benin, Aruan adalah raksasa yang sanggup menyapu kota Benin dengan pohon palem.
claims.quote: According to Benin's oral history, Aruan was a giant who could sweep the city of Benin using palm trees.

claims.statement: Spelled Arhuanran or Aruanran, he lost the royal succession due to the circumstances of birth.
claims.statement_id: Kadang dieja Arhuanran atau Aruanran, Aruan kehilangan takhta kerajaan karena kondisi kelahirannya.
claims.quote: Sometimes spelled as Arhuanran or Aruanran, Aruan was destined to be an Oba of Benin Kingdom, but the circumstances surrounding his birth meant he lost the throne to his younger brother who was born the same day.

claims.statement: Oral history states Prince Idubor was born in the morning but failed to cry at birth.
claims.statement_id: Sejarah lisan menyebutkan Prince Idubor lahir di pagi hari tetapi tidak menangis ketika lahir.
claims.quote: Benin Oral history says that Prince Idubor, who later became Aruan, was born in the morning but didn't cry at birth.

claims.statement: His brother Prince Osawe, who became Oba Esigie, was born in the afternoon and cried first.
claims.statement_id: Saudaranya, Prince Osawe yang kemudian menjadi Oba Esigie, lahir di sore hari dan menangis terlebih dahulu.
claims.quote: His brother Prince Osawe, on the other hand, who later became Oba Esigie, was born in the afternoon by Queen Idia and cried first.

claims.statement: As compensation, his father appointed him the Duke of Udo, near Benin City.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai kompensasi karena kehilangan takhta, ayahnya mengangkatnya menjadi Duke of Udo dekat Benin City.
claims.quote: As compensation for missing out on becoming Oba of Benin, his father, Oba Ozolua, made him the Duke of Udo, a town not far from Benin City.

claims.statement: Beher was the pre-Christian Eritrean and Ethiopian (Aksumite) god of the sea.
claims.statement_id: Beher adalah dewa laut pra-Kristen Aksumite di Eritrea dan Ethiopia.
claims.quote: Beher was the pre-Christian Eritrean and Ethiopian (Aksumite) god of the sea.

claims.statement: He was part of a trinity with Astar and Mahrem in pre-Christian religion.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah bagian dari trinitas agama pra-Kristen bersama Astar dan Mahrem.
claims.quote: He was part of a trinity of pre-Christian Eritrean and Ethiopian religion, together with Astar (god of sun and moon) and Mahrem (god of war and head god).

claims.statement: Beher may be related to the Tewahedo Christian term for God, egziabher.
claims.statement_id: Nama Beher kemungkinan berkaitan dengan istilah egziabher dalam tradisi Kristen Tewahedo.
claims.quote: Beher may be related to one of the main Tewahedo Christian terms for god, egziabher.

claims.statement: Beher is the god of the land and sea associated with agricultural fertility.
claims.statement_id: Beher adalah dewa tanah dan laut serta diasosiasikan dengan kesuburan pertanian.
claims.quote: Beher is the god of the land and of the sea and is associated with agricultural fertility.

claims.statement: He is also identified with Meder, the earth mother.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga diidentifikasi bersama Meder, ibu bumi.
claims.quote: He is also identified with Meder, the earth mother.

claims.statement: These names appear in inscriptions of King Ezana of Axum dedicated to Astar, Beher, and Meder.
claims.statement_id: Nama-nama ini muncul bersama dalam tulisan raja Ezana of Axum yang mendedikasikan takhtanya kepada Astar, Beher, dan Meder.
claims.quote: All of these names appear together in the writings of Ezana of Axum, in which the throne is dedicated to Astar, Beher, and Meder.
